page_title: HOF 3-1 BOC | Hoffenheim v Bochum 08/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+6' None of the Bochum players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
90+5' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
90+3' The current number of shots on goal is 8:4.
90+2' The attendance is 16023.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' 3 - 1 Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and slams the ball into the top right corner. What a special shot.
88' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andrej Kramaric.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tim Oermann (Bochum) will replace Kevin Stoger.
84' Pellegrino Matarazzo decides to make a substitution. Marius Bulter will be replaced by Robert Skov (Hoffenheim).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Anton Stach trots off the pitch and is replaced by Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim).

82' Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the left post.
82' Hoffenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

76' 3 - 0 Goal! Marius Bulter hands Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the bottom right corner. 3:0.
74' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle and signals a foul after Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) brought his opponent down.
72' Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
69' Substitution. Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Takuma Asano walks off.
69' Here is a change. Anthony Losilla is going off and Thomas Letsch gives the last tactical orders to Lukas Daschner (Bochum).
68' Hoffenheim fail to score from a corner as Manuel Riemann (Bochum) leaps to collect the ball.
65' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to make a change. Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) replaces Umut Tohumcu.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Wout Weghorst departs the field of play to be replaced by Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim).
63' Booking. Manuel Riemann (Bochum) receives a caution from the referee.
62' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
60' Erhan Masovic (Bochum) has tested the patience of referee Matthias Jollenbeck and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
58' Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
56' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
53' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
52' Bochum failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
51' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) was quite harsh and Matthias Jollenbeck didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
48' The resulting set piece from Bochum is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Matus Bero is replaced by Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum).
46' Half-time substitution. Thomas Letsch decided to make a change. Philipp Hofmann is replaced by Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' The number of shots on goal at present is 6:0.

43' 2 - 0 Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) meets a perfect cross from Grischa Promel deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner via the post. It's 2:0.
41' Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
41' Takuma Asano (Bochum) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Matthias Jollenbeck no option but to blow his whistle.
37' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Matus Bero (Bochum), whose header flies narrowly wide of the right post.
35' Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
32' 1 - 0 Erhan Masovic (Bochum) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him and his teammates, it's into his own goal!

31' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) inside the box. He lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Manuel Riemann was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
30' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
28' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
25' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Anthony Losilla (Bochum) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
22' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bochum comes to nothing.
21' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Hoffenheim.
21' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Hoffenheim, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Hoffenheim will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
20' Bochum concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Hoffenheim are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
18' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
16' Takuma Asano (Bochum) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
14' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
12' The corner is swung in but Bochum can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
7' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
6' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Matthias Jollenbeck blows for a foul.
4' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Bochum will have the kick-off.
Matthias Jollenbeck will officiate today.
